high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie indoors. The individual is wearing a black T-shirt with a colorful graphic design that appears to depict a nebula or galaxy with stars and a rainbow-like arc at the bottom. The person has short, dark hair and is wearing glasses. There is a small tattoo visible on their left arm. The background features a window with white bars and a curtain rod holding patterned curtains. The curtains have a dark base color with gold swirling designs. Above the window, there is a white electrical outlet with a plug inserted into it.
